question: What is the Resulticks acquisition supposed to unlock — revenue synergies or cost savings?

beat.line: The risk is integration complexity across four absorbed acquisitions.
beat.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beat.action: The previous chip slides off as the arrow unfolds into a paper map; four folders land on it one by one and stack unevenly.

sources: Diginex has now absorbed four distinct acquisitions (Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, Resulticks) across multiple geographies.
warnings: headline number "4" not found as a figure in cited sentences [10,11] (fine if it is a count of items those sentences enumerate; flagged either way)
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: four paper folders; a paper map.
Opens on the arrow, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off as the arrow unfolds into a paper map; four folders land on it one by one and stack unevenly.
Ends holding on the folder stack.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "4 ACQUISITIONS".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "4 ACQUISITIONS". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "The risk is integration complexity across four absorbed acquisitions.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage in a 2D motion design style, photographed flat under soft, consistent room light coming from the upper left. <Picture 1> serves as the starting state, featuring a light blue ground, a cream paper chip with the text "WALLET SHARE", and black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of coins and a cream arrow, all with rough white torn-paper edges and small soft shadows. Immediately upon the first frame, the camera remains in a Static Shot as the previous composition clears: the "WALLET SHARE" chip and the coins slide rapidly off-frame. Simultaneously, the background ground transforms into a single, unbroken block of deep magenta matte printed paper. The cream arrow from the previous scene remains and rapidly unfolds, its paper surface creasing and expanding to transform into a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a blank paper map with rough white torn edges. As the map settles, a cream paper chip with the headline "4 ACQUISITIONS" printed in large, extra-bold black sans-serif typography lands sharply in the upper third of the frame with a slight overshoot, remaining stable and uncovered. In the lower two-thirds, four black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of blank paper folders enter the frame one by one in quick succession, landing with slight overshoots to stack unevenly atop the map. Every element, including the folders and map, is unmarked and blank, with no lettering or symbols. The final two seconds hold on this composition, with a subtle, slow-pulsing loop of the folder stack's position. All surfaces are matte paper with visible print dots and textures, casting soft shadows to the bottom right. (S1), a narrator with a warm, clear, and natural adult voice, speaks in an off-screen voiceover with a brisk but unhurried pace, while the on-screen elements move: <d>[English] The risk is integration complexity across four absorbed acquisitions.</d>

overall_soundscape: Crisp, tactile foley sounds of paper manipulation. A sequence of sharp, rhythmic paper-slaps and the sticky, brief sound of tape being pressed down accompany each element landing on the magenta ground.
